title: Understanding Redux Store
overview: The Redux Store contains the complete state of an application. It acts as a single source of truth for managing shared data.

example.title: Create Store Concept
example.content:
Application State
        ↓
Redux Store
        ↓
Components Access Data

title: Creating a Redux Store
overview: A Redux store is created using configuration functions. In modern applications, Redux Toolkit is commonly used for store creation.

example.title: Store Example

title: Single Source of Truth
overview: Redux follows the principle that the complete application state should be stored in one centralized store.

example.title: Single Store
example.content:
Redux Store
 ├── User State
 ├── Product State
 └── App Settings

title: Accessing Store Data
overview: Components can access Redux store data using React Redux hooks like useSelector.

title: Updating Store Data
overview: Store data is updated by dispatching actions that are handled by reducers.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned about Redux Store, creating a store, single source of truth, accessing data, and updating state.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:

✔ One store manages global data.
